reviewNotes: Kauru's other peoples (Kurama of Karku, Ruruma, Kinuku and others) are not yet mapped separately.
name: Atsam (Chawai)

summary.text: The Atsam, called Chawai by Hausa, are native to the Tsam (Chawai) chiefdom in south-eastern Kauru LGA, Kaduna State. Their language is Kainji.

areas.note: Kauru is home to about 20 languages, among them Kurama, Ruruma, Kinuku, Dungi, Bina and Rigwe.
